A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SpeeD research. Their complete main texts, appendices, equations, tables, and figures are readable and support matching retained, relocated, added, and removed material.

before.justification: v2 reports original diffusion-training experiments, including FID comparisons, acceleration curves, architecture and schedule evaluations, ablations, and generated images.

after.justification: v3 retains original experimental results and reports additional Celeb-A evaluations, BS/B-TTDM comparisons, and DiT-S/8 parameter ablations.

M1.justification: The asymmetric sampling distribution, threshold-selection rule, and change-aware weighting procedure remain unchanged. Their sections are reordered; the added DiT-S/8 experiments apply the existing method under another model configuration.

E1.justification: v3 adds conditional image generation on Celeb-A, documented in Section 3.2 and Table 10. Existing coverage of MetFaces, FFHQ, CIFAR-10, ImageNet-1K, MS-COCO, and MetFaces super-resolution remains. The additional ImageNet model configuration does not introduce a new task.

E2.justification: Appendix comparator coverage is substantially revised. v3 Table 11 adds evaluated BS and B-TTDM comparisons. v2 Table 10's 100K FFHQ comparison is removed, including ANT-UW and TskDif-Cur and the corresponding P2, Min-SNR, Log-Normal, and CLTS comparisons. The main 50K comparator set remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The supplementary evaluation design changes substantially. v3 introduces DiT-S/8 experiments with global batch size 16 at 10K/20K/40K iterations and ablations through 50K, plus BS/B-TTDM comparisons at 100K/200K/400K. v2's 100K FFHQ multi-schedule/model-size evaluations and guidance-scale sweeps are removed. Settings for retained experiments remain unchanged; Table 11's additional protocol is only described as following BS.

E4.justification: v3 removes the appendix's 100K schedule comparison, guidance-scale sensitivity tests, and FFHQ DiT-size study. It adds checkpoint-wise DiT-S/8 sensitivity to lambda, k, and previously untested threshold tau in Table 12. The baseline/P2/Min-SNR visual case comparison in v2 Figure 8 is also removed. Main-text robustness checks and ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added tables retain the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v3 adds substantial supplementary results: Table 10 reports 40K Celeb-A FID 254.9 for SpeeD versus 271.6 for DiT-S/8. Table 11 reports 400K FID 139.2 versus BS 141.8 and B-TTDM 140.5, although B-TTDM leads at 200K, 150.9 versus 151.7. v2 Tables 10–12 and Figure 8 lose result entries. Matched main results and Table 13 remain unchanged; these additions do not establish same-setting gains over v2.

T1.justification: Theorem 1, the time-region definitions, generalized process-increment analysis, auxiliary lemma, propositions, and proofs are retained. The SDE schedule table moves from v2 Table 1 to v3 Table 8 without substantive mathematical revision.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the three-region account of time steps, asymmetric sampling and change-aware weighting contributions, and claims of plug-and-play, architecture-agnostic acceleration around 3×. The shortened conclusion does not substantively redefine these claims.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanation and qualifications about excessive suppression losing useful information and excessive weighting harming performance remain. The finite-budget rationale and exclusion of ultimate-convergence comparisons move from v2 Appendix A.1 into v3's conclusion; they are not newly introduced limitations.

D1.justification: v3 supplies DiT-S/8, batch-size-16, checkpoint, and parameter-grid details for its added experiments. Existing architecture recipes, optimizer settings, hardware statements, and code/data links are retained. The new BS/B-TTDM comparison provides limited reproducibility information beyond saying its settings follow BS.

R1.justification: Appendix C adds a short discussion of DyDiT and dynamic networks, with new supporting references. Celeb-A and several bibliography-only works are also added. Core positioning against timestep weighting and sampling methods remains; BS and B-TTDM were already cited in v2.

P1.justification: v3 shortens passages and headings, places the method overview and components before the DDPM/general analysis, and moves the experimental-budget statement into the conclusion. Appendix organization and author-contribution text also change, but most explanatory prose and the overall narrative are retained.

P2.justification: The document switches from single-column to two-column layout. v2 Figure 1 is split and redrawn as v3 Figures 1–2, the SDE schedule table moves into the appendix, supplementary tables are replaced, and v2 Figure 8 is removed. Retained tables and image grids are restyled, resized, or repositioned.

improvement.justification: v3 adds useful threshold sensitivity, Celeb-A coverage, and direct BS/B-TTDM comparisons. However, it removes the longer FFHQ multi-baseline/schedule comparison and guidance/model-size robustness evidence. Its new baseline table also leaves the dataset and architecture unspecified locally. With the central results and proofs unchanged, these gains and losses do not establish a reliable net direction in overall quality.
